title: DIA Routing Slip and Report to the Joint Chiefs of Staff: Reported UFO Sighting, September 23, 1976
doc_notes: This document is a declassified DIA routing slip and a JCS message report regarding a significant UAP sighting in Tehran in September 1976.

incidents.summary: Multiple citizens in the Shemiran area of Tehran reported strange objects in the sky, described as bird-like or a helicopter with a light.
incidents.quote: some reported a kind of bird-like object while others reported a helicopter with a light on

incidents.summary: An F-4 interceptor was scrambled to investigate a bright object; the pilot experienced loss of instrumentation and communications upon approach.
incidents.quote: as the f-4 approached a range of 25 nm he lost all instrumentation and communications

incidents.summary: A second F-4 interceptor tracked a bright object on radar; the object moved away at high speed and released a second, smaller object that headed toward the F-4.
incidents.quote: another brightly lighted object, estimated to be one half to one third the apparent size of the moon, came out of the original object
